obligations: Each GPL-2.0 package in the image needs corresponding source; record per-package source pointers (Alpine aports APKBUILD with source= URLs and checksums, Debian .dsc plus upstream tar) at the pinned revision.
If the rootfs is conveyed, provide the source or a valid written offer for its GPL-2.0 packages; a distro mirror or aports tree is a pointer, not by itself the offer.
The obligation cannot be delegated to Alpine or Debian: our image distribution must carry its own source offer.
Keep per-package license metadata and NOTICE material; the image is mixed-license and is not reduced to GPL-2.0.
Whether the rootfs is a mere aggregate with the kernel is a legal question (GPL-2.0 section 2, last paragraph; GPL FAQ); record it as open and do not assert aggregation.
Include the build scripts, the U2 manifest and the pinned repository indexes that control image assembly.
This list records obligations for the research bundle; it is not a legal conclusion. The maintainer or ACR decides the distribution scope.
